# 1032. Stream of Characters

## Solution 1

```python
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, is_end = False):
        self.children = {}
        self.is_end = is_end

class StreamChecker(object):

    def __init__(self, words):
        """
        :type words: List[str]
        """
        self.root = TreeNode()
        for word in words:
            p = self.root
            for ch in word[::-1]:
                if ch not in p.children:
                    p.children[ch] = TreeNode()
                p = p.children[ch]
            p.is_end = True
        self.s = []

    def query(self, letter):
        """
        :type letter: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        self.s.append(letter)
        idx = len(self.s) - 1
        p = self.root
        while idx >= 0:
            ch = self.s[idx]
            if ch not in p.children:
                return False
            p = p.children[ch]
            if p.is_end:
                return True
            idx -= 1
        return p.is_end

# Your StreamChecker object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = StreamChecker(words)
# param_1 = obj.query(letter)
```
